outcome: dorsoposterior presentation of the fetal head
cohort: The study included 1905 women who had macrosomic fetuses (birthweight of 4000 g or more) out of 16,126 deliveries over a 5-year period.
finding: Caesarean deliveries for fetal macrosomia were associated with more maternal and neonatal complications compared to vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries for fetal macrosomia showed a statistically significant increase in maternal and neonatal complications compared to vaginal deliveries.
